import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import axios from 'axios'; import { fetchInventoryItems } from '../api/inventory'; import { fetchDueBills, fetchOverdueBills } from '../api/sales'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; const AdminDashboard = () => { const { currentUser, logout } = useAuth(); const [users, setUsers] = useState([]); const [inventoryItems, setInventoryItems] = useState([]); const [dueBills, setDueBills] = useState([]); const [overdueBills, setOverdueBills] = useState([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [error, setError] = useState(''); useEffect(() => { fetchDashboardData(); }, []); const fetchDashboardData = async () => { setLoading(true); setError(''); try { const [usersRes, inventory, due, overdue] = await Promise.all([ axios.get('/api/admin/users'), fetchInventoryItems(), fetchDueBills(), fetchOverdueBills() ]); setUsers(usersRes.data.data); setInventoryItems(inventory); setDueBills(due); setOverdueBills(overdue); } catch (err) { console.error('Error fetching dashboard data:', err); setError('Failed to load dashboard data. Please try again.'); } finally { setLoading(false); } }; if (loading) { return (
